note: ISS tiered population T1 (ISS_TIERED_POPULATION.md §12): the start's inputs. Labels S (published), D (derived), T (declared), F (a field start value matched exactly). Built by tools/modern/build_tiers_spec.py.

k_points.label: T (the owner's order: K = 4 in GDScript, 8 after the port; a parameter)

classes.label: S for the shares of adults (R67a: DINA 2019 top 10 / 1 / 0.1 %; the top 0.01 % D from the tax table); T: the class is applied uniformly to adults by age (by age NF), children 'none'; the unit sizes at E for the GDScript oracle (the PM's ruling, §11.1a, §12.7): the top 0.01 %'s about 3,000 individuals (the owner's answer 2) and its remainder in sub-bundles of 10, the top 0.1 % 30, the top 1 % 100 (D473), the top 10 % 3,000, the merged rest one bundle per cell (0); the C++ port's ladder 1 / 10 / 100 / 1,000 (D473) as unit_size_port; adults are 20 and over (R67a's DINA convention); mean_income_yen_year per class (§12.8 item 3): the bottom 50 % S (DINA 2019), the middle 40 % D (its share x the mean per adult, the mean from the bottom 50 %'s share and mean), the top 10 % less 1 %, 1 % less 0.1 % and 0.1 % less 0.01 % D from DINA's nested means, the top 0.01 % D from the tax table 2021 (the top 10,451 taxpayers: the classes above 2 億 and the rest at the 1-2 億 class mean)

type_by_band_sex.label: P(household type | 5-year band, sex): the complete 表V-1-3 (S, ten-year bands x sex x six types incl. institutions) with the split inside a ten-year band from H1's construction (D, h1tab@a5510c05, 100070 persons) raked to it

employment_by_band_sex.label: P(employment | band, sex): census 2020 labour status by 5-year age x sex (S/D, R69 §3): employed = LF x (1 - u) split regular / non-regular by the employment-type shares (officers, employers, own-account and family workers counted regular, T); unemployed LF x u; student = in school, not working; retired = other not in LF at 60+; not in LF = housework and other under 60 (T)

age_groups_by_prefecture.label: each prefecture's shares under 15, 15-64, 65-74, 75+ (census 2020, S/D, R69 §1): the seed of (0), the shape inside a group and the sex ratio national (T); the long prefecture x 5-year age x sex table is not in the repository (step 2)

labour_by_prefecture.label: each prefecture's labour-force rate and unemployment rate, both sexes, 15+ (census 2020, S/D, R69 §3; by sex NF in the repository's rows): the national age x sex profile scaled once to them, the same factor for both sexes (T)

role_by_type_band_sex.label: P(role | type, band, sex): D from H1's construction (the compositions)

size_by_type_hband.label: household size class (1, 2, 3, 4, 5+) by type x householder band: D from H1's construction

type_by_prefecture.label: D from S (国勢調査 2020 第12-1表; other = other relatives + non-relatives)

type_by_householder_age.label: D from S (国勢調査 2020 第12-1表; other = other relatives + non-relatives)

mean_size_by_prefecture.label: S (国勢調査 2020 表I-5-1; a start and monthly margin, ruling D)

income_tail.label: §12.8 item 9: the adults' survival above the generator's median runs log-linear through these lines (monthly 万円 = yen a year ÷ 12 ÷ 1e4): on the cash concept (the PM's ruling), the MOF paper's 2019 lines before matching to national income, survey + income tax: top 1 % 14.8 M and top 0.1 % 36.9 M (S, R67a §1.1 text, k_mof_ron371:598-620), top 10 % 6.6 M (D, R67a §1.4's table, no line reference); the shares before matching (8.06 %, 2.18 %) are inputs of the generalized Pareto interpolation (§12.8 10.2, the PM's option A: the MOF inputs alone); DINA's national-income lines kept as dina_lines_yen_year, not comparable; tax_top_0_01 a CHECK only (it cannot share one curve with the MOF shares, runs/gpi_feasibility; 合計所得 may include separately taxed capital gains): the top 0.01 % line D from the tax table 2021 (the 10,451st taxpayer inside the 1-2 億 class, a Pareto through N(> 1 億) = 23,670 and N(> 2 億) = 8,016); above it one Pareto whose index gives the top 0.01 %'s mean (D, classes.mean_income_yen_year[0]). Inputs of the fit, not checks

never_married.label: S (国勢調査 2020 表III-2; 45+ at the at-50 share, D): the start's one-person adults, an input

instruments_hh_trillion_yen.label: F (R67c §1.1: 国民貸借対照表 end-2022, the household sector incl. sole proprietors, 兆円)

instrument_age_profiles.label: §12.8 item 6, by householder age <30, 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s, 70s, 80+ read per adult: financial assets R67a's mean (S, 1000 yen, 全国家計構造調査 2019); land, fixed assets and inventories R67a's net wealth less financial assets (D); borrowing and other liabilities a debt profile relative per adult (T: the shape of 家計調査 2023's debt by householder age, not in the repository; R-request); each holder's weight the profile at its age x its income over its age group's mean (T)

fit.label: §12.5 F6: lexicographic; (0) and (1) exact in integers, R64's types by prefecture raked to the totals (0) and (1) allow, then an IPF in reals over the three; employment and class factors inside each cell, keyed systematic rounding; residuals reported (T1s-h, T1s-l)

wage_cash_ratio.label: §12.9 M2: b = (12 x きまって支給 + 年間賞与) ÷ (12 x 所定内) by 5-year band x sex x 正社員 / 正社員以外, D from 賃金構造基本統計調査 2022 雇用形態別 第1表 (S, pub 2023-03-17; firms 10+, general workers); a ratio on the persons layer's own 所定内 table (the PM's option A)

pension_entitlement.label: §12.9 M1: none = the survey's non-receipt share of known status (D, 国民生活基礎調査 2022 第063表, deferral included); basic_only = its share of the recipients' kinds renormalised to 100 (multiple answers, D); every other kind takes the 厚生年金 (第1号) amount classes (D: 共済 unified 2015); each kind is a mixture of its 25-year+ table and its short-record (通算老齢・25年未満) table, short_record_share = the short-record holders among the kind's holders by sex (D from 事業の概況 FY2022 counts, R70b); the amount classes per 1 万円 a month by sex (S, 事業の概況 FY2022; 厚生年金's include the basic pension), the last class open with the width that gives the published mean, at least one class (D)

hh_income_index_2021_2022.label: §12.9 M4: 毎月勤労統計 現金給与総額 index 2021 100.3 -> 2022 102.3 (D from S, 令和4年分 確報); T1s-hi's 2021 targets brought to 2022

couple_wife_employment.label: §14.2c (4): couples and employed wives by the husband's annual income class from his main job (16 classes, the lower edges in 万円 a year) and the wife's age band, D from 就業構造基本調査 2022 第240-2表 (S, pub 2023-07-21); the seed's odds ratio is the class's odds of an employed wife over the band's all-classes odds; a husband with no work income takes the first class (TO_E 03:24 (b), T until R76)

couple_spearman_both_earn.label: §14.2c (4): Spearman ρ of the two incomes among couples where both earn, by the wife's age band (D, class mid-points, R70 §1); the Gaussian copula's form T, Pearson ρ = 2 sin(π ρ_S ÷ 6)

survivors.label: §12.9 M1b: 遺族厚生年金 right holders by band (年報 FY2021, S) x recipients ÷ right holders (5.77 M FY2022 ÷ 6.07 M, D); the paid mean (概況 FY2022, S; the spread NF); all to women (by sex NF, T: a widower's entitlement is narrow); the women's 厚生-only share of the kinds by band (国民生活基礎調査 2022, D) counts the survivors already in R70's kinds

protection.label: §12.9 M1c: 被保護者調査 July 2021 (S): the elderly protected households, applied to the 65+ one-person households as an upper bound (D), and the protected households' mean minimum cost of living (housing included; medical and care aid in kind left out)

birth_month_shares.label: §14.2c (2): live births by month of birth over the year's births (S, 人口動態統計 2022 確定数 上巻 出生 第4.2表, pub 2023-09-15); a cohort without its year's row takes the nearer listed year, the earlier on a tie, before 1947 1947's (D; TO_E 03:40 (1))

marital_by_pref_sex_band.label: §14.2c (6): the shares of the known states by prefecture x sex (men, women) x 5-year band 15-19 .. 95-99, 100+ (S, 国勢調査 2020 人口等基本集計 第4-3表, pub 2021-11-30); 不詳 left out, so the known states share it in proportion (D); single ages flat within a band (D, no national single-age profile in R76; TO_E 03:40 (2))

couple_wife_work_husband_not_at_work.label: §14.2c (b): the odds of an employed wife when the husband is unemployed or out of the labour force over the odds among all couples, by the wife's age band (D from S, 労働力調査 詳細集計 2022 年平均 第V-1表, pub 2023-02-14; TO_E 03:40 (3), in place of the T row); a band with no such couples, or a rate of 0 or 1, takes 1 (T)

couples_by_age.label: §12.12: couples in general households by the husband's x the wife's 5-year band (15-19 .. 80-84, 85+), national ('0') and 47 prefectures (D, sums of S single ages), and the national single ages 15 .. 84, 85+ (S); 国勢調査 2020 人口等基本集計 第17-1表 (statInfId 000032142538, pub 2021-11-30)

couple_only_by_age.label: §12.12 (3): couple-only households by the husband's x the wife's coarse band (under 60, 60-64 .. 80-84, 85+), national ('0') and prefectures (S, 国勢調査 2020 第32表, statInfId 000032142673, pub 2021-11-30)

population_2020_by_pref_sex_band.label: §12.12 (1), T1s-w: 国勢調査 2020's persons 15+ by prefecture x sex (men, women) x 5-year band 15-19 .. 80-84, 85+ (S, 人口等基本集計 第4-3表 総数, R76)

child_window.label: §12.12 (5): per birth year the 1st-99th percentile of mother's age at birth (first births 第1子 from 1970, all births before; linear inside each age group, open groups as declared, D), and the father's at 2022's first births to married parents (D, the only father table); from S counts

nonhead_couples.label: §12.12 (9): the head's spouses, the children's spouses by sex x 5-year band (85+ open), the head's and spouse's parents who are men by band, and the two-couple households (夫婦と両親 + 夫婦，子供と両親; the upper bound adds 夫婦，(子供，)親と他の親族), national ('0') and prefectures (S counts; the couples by position they imply are D)
